_integrity_warnings.message: This answer combines analyses of different networks: find_worst_case_timestamp used base, find_worst_case_timestamp used wind_bus11_2mw. Results from different networks are not comparable — say which each figure came from, or re-run so they agree.

assistant:
On proposal **wind_bus11_2mw** (base + a 2 MW wind farm at Bus 11), the **weekly peak external-grid import** was **41.51 MW** on the base network and **41.42 MW** with the proposal, both at **2000-01-05 19:30**. The peak was about **0.09 MW lower** with the proposal.

The wind farm follows the measured wind production profile, so its actual output varies by time and may be below its 2 MW rating. Over the same 672-tick week, voltage/thermal violations occurred at 35 ticks on the base and 26 with the proposal; the proposal still had undervoltage, reaching **0.941 p.u.** at its worst. These import figures are weekly **peaks**, not average import or total imported energy.

A consistency warning arose because separate peak scans were run on the base and proposal networks; I’ve labelled their results separately. The direct comparison scan used the same measurement window for both.

📋 Data source: measurements
